Case note: A.S. No. 599/2021
Client: Simran Banerjee (hardware dealer, New Delhi)
Opposing party: M/s Sai Shipping Pvt Ltd
Court: Delhi High Court, before Justice Sudhir Dhingra
Filed on: 27 June 2021
Claim amount: INR 59,73,00,000/-
Issue: maritime salvage claim. The owners dispute the value of the salvage.
Advice given: Claim a salvage award based on the value of the property saved.
Outcome: A salvage award was fixed by the court.
Recommended next step: Recover the award from the security.
Witness: Nikhil Bhosale
Matter code: Project Eagle
